text: Employees in India receive 24 days of paid leave per year. Employees also receive 12 public holidays every year.
Planned leave should be applied through Workday before taking leave.
Akamai follows a hybrid work model. Employees work from office three days every week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
Employees can claim Rs 2000 per month for home internet reimbursement using the ExpenseIt portal before the 5th of every month.
Employees receive Rs 3000 every month as a wellness benefit for gym memberships or fitness app subscriptions.
Promotion cycles happen twice every year during March and September. Employees usually become eligible after spending at least two years at their current level.
Employees receive learning and development benefits for certifications, courses and professional development.
All employees must complete mandatory security awareness training every quarter.
